name: redis-high-cpu
title: A Redis replication group has sustained high CPU utilisation
description: A Redis primary node has had average engine CPU utilisation at or above 90% for 45 minutes.
investigation_steps: Open the alarm to identify the affected Redis replication group.
Check connection counts, command activity, memory usage and application demand.
Determine whether an application problem or insufficient Redis capacity is causing the sustained usage.
This could lead to service degradation or unavailability if the high CPU usage persists.
Using breakglass to temporarily increase Redis capacity may be necessary to restore service performance while addressing the underlying issue.
